natural_window.prewindow_rule: O receipt, U receipt, and active Foundation journal must all be present and hash-sealed no later than cutoff.
natural_window.postwindow_rule: Active runtime outcome receipt must be from the same natural session and is intentionally excluded from the prewindow hash set.

required_sequence: Recover same-cutoff formal O receipt from its accepted authority.
Recover same-cutoff formal U receipt from its accepted authority.
Re-read active Foundation journal and validate append-only parent/hash chain.
Run dsa_natural_parallel_prewindow_v1.py before cutoff and preserve immutable external timestamp provenance.
Do not run candidate journal writer and do not alter Gate-D authority.
After the active Gate-D natural window completes, read the active runtime receipt for the same session.
Run dsa_readonly_candidate_adapter_v1.py with comparison_kind=natural_parallel using the sealed attestation.
If action diverges, block migration. If action matches but control state diverges, submit discrepancy to Central Audit. If both match, submit normal Central Audit package.
forbidden: Using post-cutoff O/U inputs as if they were pre-cutoff
Resetting or truncating the active Foundation journal
Writing the candidate Drive journal for migration proof
Merging PR #2 as a substitute for migration acceptance
